text.en: Please introduce yourself and tell me why you are applying for this on-the-job training.
text.fil: Pakilala ang iyong sarili at sabihin kung bakit ka nag-aapply sa on-the-job training na ito.

criteria.name: Relevant background
criteria.description: Connects program, skills or projects to the training role.
key_points: mentions a skill or project related to the role
gives a reason connected to the company or role

5: I am a fourth-year Computer Engineering student. I built an IoT attendance system with an ESP32 for our capstone, and I want to train here because your team develops embedded products, which is the field I want to grow in.
3: I am a Computer Engineering student. I like programming and I want to gain experience in a real company.
1: I am a student. I need to do OJT because it is required.

criteria.correction: Link your introduction to the role: name one project or skill that fits the job and say why this company in particular.

criteria.name: Clear and concise
criteria.description: Organized answer, about 30 to 60 seconds, no rambling.
key_points: ends with why they are applying

5: Good morning. I am Ana, a fourth-year Electronics Engineering student. My strengths are circuit design and troubleshooting, which I used in our PCB project. I am applying because I want hands-on experience in your testing department.
3: So, I am Ana, I study electronics, and I also do some projects, like many projects in school, and I want to apply here because it is near and I want experience.
1: Um, I don't know, I am just, ano, a student here, yeah.

criteria.correction: Use a simple order: who you are, what you can do, why you want this training. Keep it under one minute.

text.en: Tell me about a time you worked in a team and faced a disagreement. What did you do?
text.fil: Ikuwento ang isang pagkakataon na nagtrabaho ka sa isang team at nagkaroon ng hindi pagkakasundo. Ano ang ginawa mo?

criteria.name: Situation, action, result
criteria.description: Describes a specific situation, their own action, and the result.

5: In our microprocessors project, two members wanted different sensors. I suggested we test both for one day and compare accuracy. The ultrasonic sensor won, everyone agreed, and we finished a week early.
3: We had a disagreement in a group project about the design. We talked about it and eventually we agreed and finished the project.
1: I always get along with everyone so we never had problems.

criteria.correction: Tell one real story in three parts: the situation, what you did, and how it ended.

criteria.name: Personal contribution
criteria.description: Shows their own role and what they learned, without blaming others.
key_points: uses I statements for their role

5: I took the role of mediator. I listened to both sides, proposed a test, and documented the results. I learned that data settles arguments faster than opinions.
3: We all decided together what to do and it worked out fine.
1: My groupmates were lazy so I did everything myself.

criteria.correction: Say clearly what you did yourself and one thing you learned from it.

text.en: What is one weakness you are working on, and how are you improving it?
text.fil: Ano ang isang kahinaan na pinagtatrabahuhan mo, at paano mo ito pinapabuti?

criteria.name: Genuine weakness
criteria.description: Names a real, work-relevant weakness, not a disguised strength.
key_points: explains how it affects their work

5: I used to underestimate how long debugging takes, so I missed some deadlines in our embedded systems course.
3: Sometimes I am not very confident when speaking.
1: My weakness is that I am a perfectionist and I work too hard.

criteria.correction: Pick a real weakness that matters at work, and explain briefly how it affected you.

criteria.name: Improvement plan
criteria.description: Describes concrete steps already taken to improve.

5: Now I add a debugging buffer to every task estimate and track my actual time in a spreadsheet. This semester I submitted every lab on time.
3: I am trying to improve it by practicing more.
1: I don't really know how to fix it.

criteria.correction: Add a specific action you are taking and one sign that it is working.
